Bug_Title: IL: An apparent infinite recursive loop (IL_INFINITE_RECURSIVE_LOOP)
Bug_Details:
This method unconditionally invokes itself. This would seem to indicate
an infinite recursive loop that will result in a stack overflow.
Bug_Explanation: The method recursiveMethod unconditionally calls itself without any terminating condition, leading to an infinite recursive loop causing a stack overflow error.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method, which in turn calls recursiveMethod. The recursiveMethod unconditionally invokes itself, leading to an infinite recursive loop and a StackOverflowError, thereby triggering the bug.
Test_Run_Result: Runninng test will fail system because of infinite loop.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that running the test will fail the system because of an infinite loop, confirming the presence of an infinite recursive loop as described in the bug information.
